state.seed_assertion: A DPIA must assess the origin, nature, particularity and gravity of risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.

sentences.1: A DPIA must assess the origin, nature, particularity and gravity of risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.2: The risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects are managed [article 35, paragraph 7, point c)]: The origin, the nature, the particularity and the gravity of the risks are assessed (recital 84)
sentences.3: A data protection impact assessment is required when processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.4: If you have determined that the processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, you must carry out a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for each processing operation.
sentences.5: A DPIA may also be carried out on a voluntary basis in order to identify and deal as effectively as possible with the risks, even if they are minor, to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.6: The measures and safeguards provided to protect the rights and freedoms of data subjects under the GDPR;
sentences.7: A data protection impact assessment must include an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.8: (c)an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects referred to in paragraph 1
sentences.9: A data protection impact assessment is required when a type of processing, particularly using new technologies and considering the nature, scope, context and purposes, is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.
sentences.10: A DPIA should identify all relevant risks to individuals' rights and freedoms, assess their likelihood and severity, and detail all relevant mitigations.
sentences.11: A Data Protection Impact Assessment must be conducted when a type of processing, particularly involving new technologies and considering the nature, scope, context and purposes, is likely to result in high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
